note: Golden cases for split-plan@1 (framework/spec/BUILD-SPLIT.md). `in` is hand-written; `out` is generated from the reference engine (framework/core/build-split.mjs). Every port replays `in` and must answer `out`. ids: split id, part ref, branch and session formats. plans: planParts(build, freeSlots, fileClaims) at 2026-11-18T12:00:00.000Z. validate: mutations of the three-part plan of `build` and the errors each must raise. machine: scripts of part events (partNext), failures (onPartFailed), run moves (runNext), roll-ups (applyRollUp) and readiness probes (combineReady) on the three-part plan of validate.build, op k stamped 2026-11-18T12:<k+1>:00.000Z. transitions (out only): PART_TRANSITIONS, RUN_TRANSITIONS, partTarget(status, event) for every status and event ('' = does not apply), PART_WORKING, RUN_TERMINAL, PARTS_PHASE and buildStatusOf per run state. rollUps: `rollUp` = rollUp(parts, maxRebuilds), what the parts alone imply, and `badge` = rollUpBadge({ run, parts, maxRebuilds }), the queue row's overall status (maxRebuilds defaults to 2; junk entries are dropped before the badge). combine: combineReady(normSplit(plan, { build: 'demo' })). failures: onPartFailed(normSplit(plan, { build: 'demo' }), part, why, at 2026-11-18T12:00:00.000Z), answered as { ok, action, resetSteps, why, run, parts: [{ id, status, rebuilds, lastError }], failure }.
